WITH execution_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    ordersmark,
    COUNT(*) as exec_count
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
),
total_executions AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count
  FROM orderexecutions
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    ec.ordersmark,
    ec.exec_count,
    CAST(ec.exec_count AS DECIMAL) / CAST(te.total_count AS DECIMAL) as share
  FROM execution_counts ec
  CROSS JOIN total_executions te
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share_val
  FROM shares
),
with_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    s.ordersmark,
    s.exec_count,
    s.share,
    s.share - av.avg_share_val as diff
  FROM shares s
  CROSS JOIN avg_share av
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    ordersmark,
    exec_count,
    share,
    diff,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST) as rnk
  FROM with_diff
)
SELECT 
  ordersmark,
  exec_count,
  share,
  diff,
  rnk
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= 10
ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST;

assumptions.assumption: At least one execution record exists in the orderexecutions table (to avoid division by zero when computing share)

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude the rank column from output if strictly interpreting 'List the order reference, execution count, share, and share minus the average share' literally—the rank value still filters the result set but is not displayed
